title: CancellationFaultChanged v1 payload
description: Staff set another fault on this cancelled order (ADR 0019 point 4). fault_before is null for an order cancelled before ADR 0019. driver_id: the driver who was on the order when it was cancelled, whose counted cancellation follows the fault; left out when there was none. The operator's points follow a change to or from OPERATOR.

examples.comment: The driver was 20 minutes late; the rider called
